tasks.subject: Task 1: ThemeContext + useTheme hook
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the context, provider, and hook that own theme mode and persist it across launches.

**Files:**
- Create: contexts/ThemeContext.tsx

**Verify:** npx tsc --noEmit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["contexts/ThemeContext.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["useTheme returns mode, effectiveScheme, colors, setMode", "first launch defaults to 'system' and follows OS", "setMode persists to AsyncStorage and updates immediately", "OS theme changes propagate while mode is system"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wrap app with ThemeProvider, route hooks through it
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Insert ThemeProvider at the root and re-route the legacy hooks/use-color-scheme*.ts and hooks/use-theme-color.ts to read from the new context.

**Files:**
- Modify: app/_layout.tsx, hooks/use-color-scheme.ts, hooks/use-color-scheme.web.ts, hooks/use-theme-color.ts

**Verify:** npx tsc --noEmit && npx expo start (boots without error)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/_layout.tsx", "hooks/use-color-scheme.ts", "hooks/use-color-scheme.web.ts", "hooks/use-theme-color.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ThemeProvider wraps AuthProvider", "useColorScheme returns active effective scheme", "useThemeColor reads from active scheme", "app boots without runtime error"]}
```

{"files": ["app/login.tsx", "app/register.tsx", "app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx", "app/(tabs)/profile.tsx", "app/(tabs)/index.tsx", "app/(tabs)/cookbook.tsx", "app/(tabs)/shopping.tsx", "components/parallax-scroll-view.tsx", "components/ui/collapsible.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no file outside ThemeContext + 3 hooks imports useColorScheme from react-native", "every screen renders correctly"]}
